original_text:
Living things:
1.are organized
2.acquire material and energy
3.maintain homeostasis
4.respond
5.can reproduce
6.can develop
7.have adaptations

These 7 characteristics drive every unit of study we will explore this year!
Evolution, genetics, ecology, cytology, etc!
explanation: This page summarizes the seven fundamental characteristics of life that define living organisms: structural organization, acquisition of materials and energy, homeostasis (maintenance of biological balance), response to the environment/other organisms, capacity for reproduction, development through specific stages, and evolutionary adaptations. These 7 core concepts form the foundation for all units covered in the course, including evolution, genetics, ecology, and cytology.

questions.q: Which fields of biological study are mentioned as being driven by the 7 characteristics of life?
questions.exp: The slide explicitly lists: 'Evolution, genetics, ecology, cytology, etc!' as subjects driven by these seven characteristics.
